person_note: The controlling narration is third person, primarily shifting among limited character perspectives. The authorized opening follows Edgar externally and enters his perceptions and thoughts, while interior Goodreads quotations similarly present Aldred, Hubert, and Ragna's consciousness through external third-person narration. First- and second-person forms in the quote set occur in dialogue, reported sayings, or generic maxims rather than sustained base narration. The whole-book POV description explicitly confirms third person and explains the viewpoint shifts; no credible evidence indicates sustained first- or second-person sections. The publisher excerpt covers only the opening, but the independent whole-book description and distributed interior quote evidence remove the main scope uncertainty.
